snippets.text: Urticarial vasculitis (UV) is a condition clinically characterized by wheals lasting more than 24 h. From a histopathological point of view, it shows leukocytoclastic vasculitis of small vessels. UV is thought to be a type III hypersensitivity reaction, mediated by the formation of immune-complexes.
